scope: Two authored four-turn conversations, frozen before this comparison. Not held-out customer data. Initial terms are the same for every arm. No tuning or retries after observing results.

events.text: The all-in price is 30.00 DEMO. Delivery takes 10 minutes from escrow funding.
I offer 25.00 DEMO for the same job. I need delivery in 5 minutes from escrow funding.
I can do 26.00 DEMO instead. The latest delivery terms and all other requirements stay unchanged.
I accept the seller's latest offer without any changes.
For 15.00 DEMO I will provide an annual CAPEX forecast for 2025, not quarterly actuals.
I cannot include original official source cells. All my other proposed terms remain unchanged.
I will instead provide actual quarterly facility investment cash outflow for 2025-Q1, 2025-Q2, 2025-Q3 and 2025-Q4. Original official source cells are included. The price stays as last quoted.
It could be 25.00 DEMO or 28.00 DEMO; I have not chosen a price.
